messages:
Maria: Heads-up — spotted a weird edge-case: a tenant ended up routed into the shadow bucket in the preview pipeline, but the effective routing used the old cohort. Not sure if its a hash drift or an inheritance mismatch.
Ben: ugh, can you paste the applier logs?
Maria: heres the snippet I grabbed from staging:
```
WARN 2026-02-12T16:12:03Z config-applier v2 tenant=tenant-42 orphan_shadow=true inherited_from=global:v17 applied=v16 checksum_expected=abc123 checksum_actual=abf123
```
Sasha: interesting — looks like the preview pipeline computed bucket using the newer config, but the applied route came from an older in-memory snapshot. Might be race between config-publish and snapshot-rotation.
Kevin: telemetry question: do we already emit an event when effective != intended? we should. if not, add config.apply.effective_mismatch with tenant_id, intended_version, actual_version, checksum_diff.
Tess: from UX side, we also need the console to show "preview vs effective" per-tenant (small sample) and highlight orphaned tenants. right now preview only shows global diffs.
Maria: agree. short-term mitigation: fallback rule to force preview->effective parity for flagged tenants (rollback to global) and a dry-run sampling to detect others. long-term: include an "anchor_hash" in the config apply response so clients can verify stickiness math.
Ben: question — do we change hashing algorithm or add a stickiness_key field? changing hash could cause massive churn.
Sasha: dont change the hash. Add a stable stickiness_key and include in rollout metadata. Also add effective_checksum in apply response so the console and telemetry can reconcile.
Kevin: rollout plan idea: expose a config flag enable_shadow_bucket_stability with staged percentages (0.1, 1, 5, 25, 100) + sampling telemetry. create a dashboard that shows mismatch_rate, orphan_count, and avg-latency-impact.
Maria: I can implement backend check that compares intended_bucket vs applied_bucket and emit an event. will also add a preview-highlighting flag in console.
Tess: please add a runbook entry for the kill-switch: if mismatch_rate > 0.5% for >10m we automatically pause preview rollouts and notify oncall. include links to steps for reverting to last-good snapshot.
ops-bot: alert: config-applier v2 retry loop observed for tenant-42 (3 retries) — auto-debug dump pushed to /var/logs/config-applier/tenant-42/2026-02-12.log
Ben: sgtm. small nit: telemetry should sample 1% of requests with full payload to help reproduce hashing locally.
Sasha: also add an idempotency token for apply operations so we can correlate publishes to applied snapshots. name it publish_txn_id.
Kevin: once backend change is up, let's run a shadow check for 24h against a 5% cohort, collect metrics, then proceed with staged percentages. Ill add the dashboard panel and an alert.
Maria: timeline: Ill open a PR for the effective_checksum + publish_txn_id today, add the emit event, and wire up a minimal console diff view. aim to have a first smoke test on staging by EOD tomorrow.
Tess: thanks — ping me for UX review. remember to add the kill-switch toggle in the console (ops-visible) and an annotation on any automatic pause.
Ben: :+1:
Sasha: one more thought — record the client-supplied stickiness_key in telemetry so we can detect misbehaving SDKs.
Maria: good call. adding that to the event schema.
Kevin: ok moving forward. Ill draft the dashboard panels and alert thresholds and post the link here when ready.
Tess: cheers, team.
Maria: filing follow-ups: 1) PR for checksum & txn id 2) runbook entry + kill-switch 3) console preview diffs 4) dashboard panel + alert. will link items in the PR.
